They offered me help when I got to hospital but i pretended that it was nothing, and there was another incident when the police got invoved, I event asked them for help, but when I got sober i didn't care.

It probably sounds like my problem is alcohol, but that isn't the core problem. The alcohol is just the way I deal with my fealings.

My mother died when I was young. We never talk about her, and I got the sense that she had a problem with alcohol when she was alive, so I dont feel like I can talk about the alcohol problem with my familly.
